definitions.explanation: The examination of a patient by a doctor to diagnose illness.

examples.japanese: {午前|ごぜん}{中|ちゅう}に{診察|しんさつ}の{予約|よやく}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I made an appointment for a morning examination.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}が{丁寧|ていねい}に{診察|しんさつ}してくださった。
{診察|しんさつ}{室|しつ}でお{待|ま}ちください。
examples.english: Please wait in the examination room.

notes:
{診察|しんさつ}する is used as a する-verb meaning "to examine (a patient)."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {診察|しんさつ}を{受|う}ける (to receive an examination)
- {診察|しんさつ}{室|しつ} (examination room)
- {診察|しんさつ}{時間|じかん} (consultation hours)
- {診察|しんさつ}{券|けん} (patient registration card)
- {診察|しんさつ}{料|りょう} (consultation fee)

RELATED MEDICAL TERMS:
- {初診|しょしん} (first visit/examination)
- {再診|さいしん} (follow-up visit)
- {問診|もんしん} (medical interview)
